description: Calls GET /v1/templates/{templateId}. Returns the full template record for a known id. Use this instead of jsonfabrica_list_templates when you already have the `templateId` (e.g. from a prior create/list call); it is also the recommended way to inspect current `body`/`tags`/`description` before calling jsonfabrica_update_template, since update only shows you the fields you send, not the result of merging them with what already exists. Read-only, no side effects.

templateId.description: ID of the template to fetch, as returned by create/list. Required.

name: jsonfabrica_get_template

astCache.description: Server-internal parsed-body cache; opaque to callers.

description.description: Free-text description, if any was stored.

validated.description: Whether the body passed static template validation.

title: Get a JsonFabrica template
